xccdf:Profile.xccdf:title: Portico appliance (CIS Level 1 Server with documented exceptions)
xccdf:Profile.xccdf:description: The CIS Level 1 Server profile as shipped by scap-security-guide, minus the rules below. Podman's bridge network needs IP forwarding on the appliance (Keycloak and PostgreSQL run as containers on an internal bridge); the host is not a router towards any other network: firewalld forwards nothing.
